title: JSFL fl.publishDocument() missing from runtime
description:
Flash 8 JSFL: fl.publishDocument(doc, publishProfile) is a standard top-level method on the fl object that triggers a SWF publish for the given document. It is absent from both the JsflFl TypeScript interface and the makeFlProxy return object in packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts.

Impact: Any JSFL script (or agent) that calls fl.publishDocument(fl.getDocumentDOM()) will throw a runtime error (fl.publishDocument is not a function or similar), silently failing to publish. This is a common pattern in Flash 8 JSFL automation scripts.

What exists: doc.publish() (returns Uint8Array) and doc.exportSWF(fileURL) (triggers browser download) are both implemented. fl.publishDocument should delegate to doc.exportSWF() on the given document with a default filename.

Fix: Add publishDocument(doc: JsflDocument, publishProfile?: string): void to the JsflFl interface (after the saveDocument entry around line 3986), and implement it in makeFlProxy (after the saveDocument implementation around line 4189) by calling doc.exportSWF() with a default 'movie.swf' filename. The publishProfile param is accepted for API compatibility but can be ignored (always Default).

Files: packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts -- interface ~line 3986, implementation ~line 4189
